items.name: Mean Girls
items.desc: When homeschooled Cady Heron enters the brutal ecosystem of an American high school, she’s quickly pulled into the orbit of the Plastics, the school’s most powerful clique. What starts as a plan to infiltrate and expose them spirals into Cady becoming exactly what she set out to destroy. Sharp, quotable, and endlessly rewatchable, Mean Girls is a satire on popularity, insecurity, and teenage cruelty, balancing absurd humour with surprisingly sharp observations about identity, friendship, and how easy it is to lose yourself when validation becomes the goal.
